description: One-click retouch of an exterior listing photo: a natural sky where it is dull, a healthy lawn where the grass is dead, a clean driveway, and bins, hoses and other clutter removed — each only where needed, with the house unchanged. Costs credits from the user's Pixly balance.

fix.description: Which areas the tool may touch: 'sky', 'lawn', 'hardscape' (driveway, paths, patio), 'clutter' (bins, hoses, tools, a stray vehicle). Omit for all four; each is fixed only where the photo needs it.

imageUrl.description: Public https URL of the source photo, or a data: URI. Either imageUrl or r2Path is required.

r2Path.description: Storage path of a photo already in the user's Pixly library (from list_library, or returned by an upload ticket) — the alternative to imageUrl.

name: touch_up_exterior

status.description: pending | processing | completed | failed — anything not completed/failed is still running

title: Exterior Touch-up
